scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with an exact rational checker; finite computations and simulations are corroboration, not substitutes for infinite-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only a fully specified standard Cauchy null, n >= 2 and exponential spectral weights of positive parameter a. It does not treat estimated location/scale, test power, or practical critical values. The fixed-sample almost-sure endpoint is established in the original literature; the new contribution is an exact finite-n variance and its non-L2 boundary. Historical priority remains qualified; no independent validation is claimed.
title: Exact finite-null variance and singular small-bandwidth fluctuations of the Cauchy Fourier–Stein statistic
